steps.say: Ambiguous newborns are grouped before testing. DSD classification is applied using karyotype first. Forty six XX DSD is staged covering virilized females. Forty six XY DSD is staged covering undervirilized males. Sex chromosome DSD is staged including mixed gonadal dysgenesis. Forty five X with forty six XY is the classic mosaic.
steps.tx: **DSD classification** (sex development groups) sorts newborns into **46,XX DSD** (virilized female conditions), **46,XY DSD** (undervirilized male conditions), and sex chromosome DSD including **mixed gonadal dysgenesis** (45,X/46,XY mosaic gonad disorder). Send karyotype with hormones before assigning sex. Counsel families with genetics input, because labels shape lifelong care.

steps.say: Salt wasting newborns are tested for CAH first. Congenital adrenal hyperplasia is ranked topping ambiguous genitalia causes. Twenty one hydroxylase deficiency is blamed in most cases. CYP21A2 mutations are staged disrupting cortisol synthesis. Aldosterone loss is staged wasting salt with water. Cortisol with fludrocortisone rescue is started at once.
steps.tx: **21-hydroxylase deficiency** (cortisol block), **CYP21A2** (enzyme gene) mutation, causes most ambiguous genitalia as 46,XX DSD with **salt wasting crisis** (salt losing emergency). Replace cortisol with fludrocortisone at once. Monitor electrolytes with 17-hydroxyprogesterone levels, because undertreatment crises and overtreatment stunts growth with weight gain.

The map shows **CYP21A2 deficiency** blocking cortisol and aldosterone paths while stored **17 OHP** shunts right into excess adrenal androgens. Low salt markers flag **salt wasting** on the left while rescue pills restore missing hormones. Read the block as virilization with collapse risk because one enzyme fault drives both effects.
steps.say: The adrenal gland sits at top with arrows running down three paths. Two red crosses block the middle and left paths so cortisol and salt hormone cannot form. The blocked building block piles up and spills to the right into excess male type hormones. Salt loss shows near the kidneys below while replacement capsules point back to the blocked steps.

vis.alt: Adrenal pathway map showing blocked cortisol and salt routes with excess precursors shunted toward androgens and rescue capsules marked.
vis.caption: Blocked enzyme path spilling into androgens, Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.say: Virilization is graded carefully before surgery. Prader staging is applied from one to five routinely. Stage one is staged showing mild clitoromegaly alone. Stage five is staged showing phallic urethra with fused scrotum. Intermediate stages are staged blending the features progressively. Surgical planning is staged following the assigned stage.
steps.tx: **Prader staging** (virilization scale) grades 46,XX CAH females from **Stage I to V** (one to five) with **virilization** (male pattern growth) from mild clitoromegaly to phallic urethra with fused scrotum. Stage every newborn before family counselling. Plan feminizing surgery by stage, because anatomy sets technique.

steps.say: Phenotypic girls are staged carrying XY chromosomes here. Complete androgen insensitivity is staged in such presentations routinely. Androgen receptor mutations are staged blocking all male signalling. Female externals with blind vaginal pouch are found. Uterus is absent with abdominal or inguinal testes. Gonads are removed after puberty completes routinely.
steps.tx: **CAIS** (complete androgen resistance), 46,XY DSD from **androgen receptor mutation** (male signal block), presents as female externals with **blind vaginal pouch** (short ending vagina), absent uterus, and inguinal or abdominal testes. Raise as female with gonadectomy after puberty. Screen for inguinal hernias in girls, because testes hide there.

vis.alt: Androgen insensitivity anatomy showing inguinal testes, absent uterus, blind vaginal pouch, and mutated androgen receptor.
vis.caption: CAIS: female externals with blind pouch, no uterus, and inguinal testes. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Some babies are staged virilizing dramatically at puberty here. Five alpha reductase deficiency is staged in such histories routinely. SRD5A2 mutations are staged blocking dihydrotestosterone formation. Perineoscrotal hypospadias is noted carefully at birth. Phallic growth with virilization is staged following testosterone rise. Male assignment is discussed carefully before puberty.
steps.tx: **5-alpha reductase deficiency** (DHT block), 46,XY DSD from **SRD5A2** (enzyme gene) mutation, shows pseudovaginal perineoscrotal hypospadias at birth with **pubertal virilization** (male growth at teens) as testosterone rises. Discuss male assignment before puberty hits. Counsel families early, because gender role often follows virilization.

steps.say: Y bearing dysgenetic gonads are staged threatening cancer lifelong. Gonadoblastoma risk is staged highest in such gonads. Intra-abdominal streaks with Y material are removed early routinely. Prophylactic gonadectomy is booked promptly before malignancy. Scrotal testes are watched carefully instead with imaging. Biopsy is staged guiding borderline decisions before final surgery.
steps.tx: **Gonadoblastoma** (Y gonad tumour) risk peaks in intra-abdominal **dysgenetic gonads** (streak Y gonads) with GBY material, mandating early **prophylactic gonadectomy** (preventive gonad removal). Remove before malignant shift while preserving scrotal testes under watch. Stage surgery with genetics input, because risk varies by mosaic pattern.

steps.say: High confluence is staged needing single unit repair here. Urogenital mobilization is staged for high junctions routinely. The urethra with vagina is mobilized together as one. Perineal delivery is staged avoiding separate flaps. Clitorovaginoplasty is completed in the same sitting routinely. Catheter drainage is staged protecting the join afterwards.
steps.tx: **Urogenital mobilization** (single unit repair), **PUM** (partial mobilization) or total TUM, brings the urethra-vagina confluence to perineum without separate vaginal flaps, completing **clitorovaginoplasty** (clitoris vagina rebuild) in one sitting. Splint with catheter drainage afterwards. Stage with endocrine control optimized, because healing needs hormonal calm.

steps.say: Clitoral surgery is staged sparing feeling always. Nerve sparing clitoroplasty is staged for enlarged organs routinely. The dorsal neurovascular bundle is dissected away very carefully. Erectile tissue is reduced while nerves are kept fully intact. Glans volume is recessed carefully preserving sensation. Appearance with function is balanced carefully together.
steps.tx: **Nerve-sparing clitoroplasty** (feeling saving reduction) dissects the **dorsal neurovascular bundle** (sensation cable) off erectile tissue, recessing glans volume while preserving sensation. Operate with loupe magnification and counsel on sensation goals. Review appearance with function at puberty, because growth revises results over time.
